📋 Terms & Conditions

Last updated: July 2026 · ASA RIDE, ASA Group of Companies · Pan India

1. Driver Onboarding

  • Joining fee: ₹0 (Lifetime FREE)
  • KYC: Free · Security deposit: ₹0 · Registration: ₹0
  • Approval within 24 hours of complete documents
  • Age 20+ mandatory · Valid licence required
  • IMEI-locked device — only registered device can access driver app

2. Commission Rates

  • Bike Taxi: 10% platform fee
  • Auto: 12% · E-Rickshaw: 12% · Airport Ride: 12%
  • Mini Cab / Sedan / SUV: 15%
  • Premium Car: 18%
  • Intercity / Rental: 10%
  • 🎉 Launch offer: 0% commission first 100 rides

3. Payouts

  • Daily payout available
  • Instant withdrawal available
  • Weekly & monthly performance bonus

4. Cancellation Charges

  • Bike / Auto / E-Rickshaw: ₹25 after driver accepts
  • Car (Mini/Sedan/SUV/Premium): ₹45 after driver accepts

5. First Ride Discount

Auto/Bike/E-Rick: 15% off · Cab: 20% off · Code: ASAFIRST

6. Refer & Earn

  • Customer refer: Available · Driver refer: Available
  • YouTuber program: 500 confirmed rides = 5 FREE inner city rides

7. Services Available

Bike Taxi, Auto, Cab, Intercity Cab, Parcel Delivery, Courier Delivery, Advance Booking, Schedule Ride, Round Trip, One Way, Corporate Booking, Airport Transfer. Payment: Cash, UPI, Cards, Wallet.

8. Safety

SOS button, live tracking, women safety features, 24×7 support, driver insurance (partner plan).

9. Bike Safety

2 helmets mandatory for bike drivers at all times.

10. Contact

🔒 Privacy Policy

ASA RIDE · Effective: July 2026 · Pan India

1. Data Collected

  • Name, mobile, email, date of birth
  • Aadhaar, licence, RC (drivers)
  • Device IMEI (drivers — for app security lock)
  • Live GPS during active rides
  • Payment info via secure gateways

2. IMEI & GPS

Driver app IMEI-locked. Only registered device can login. GPS tracked during all active rides for safety.

3. Data Use

Ride booking, matching, payment processing, driver verification, refer & earn processing, safety features.

ASA RIDE is under ASA Group of Companies, also operating ASA Travels, ASA Job Portal, ASA FOOD, ASA Realty, ASA Finserv, and Shaadi Mubarak India.

Indian law. Disputes subject to competent Indian courts.
